sensor: Thermal: vanadium oxide uncooled focal plane detector, 1280x1024, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 25 mK; optical: dual 1/1.8in CMOS (channel 1 4MP 2688x1520, channel 2 8MP 3840x2160)
features: tri-sensor multi-spectral surveillance system (1280x1024 thermal + dual visible 4MP/8MP)
vanadium oxide uncooled thermal detector, NETD < 25 mK
zoom thermal lens (23-230 mm / 30-300 mm) and zoom visible lens (86x / 120x)
pan 0 to 360 endless, tilt -45 to +85, 300 presets
near-IR laser illumination up to 3000 m (optional)
laser range finder up to 6000 m, +/-1 m (optional)
target tracking (manual and alarm-triggered), tripwire, intrusion, heat detection
Electronic and Optical Image Stabilization, electronic/optical defog
large positioning-system enclosure, net weight approx. 113 kg, dome IP67 / PTZ IP66
release_notes: Ultra-series long-range multi-spectral positioning system with a 1280x1024 uncooled VOx thermal channel and dual visible channels (4MP and 8MP), optional near-IR laser illuminator to 3000 m and laser range finder to 6000 m.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible, channel 2 = thermal (additional visible channel available). Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels; PTZ via ONVIF.
